conflicts: 3p 3P lifetime: 36(4) ns (Kroell et al. 1985) versus 34.7 ns (Niemi et al., TALIF standard value, second-hand) versus 39.1(1.4) and 40(3) ns (older measurements listed by Kroell); all consistent within about 2 sigma.
4d 3D° lifetime: 23(3) ns (Kroell et al. 1985, laser) versus 80(10) ns (older electron-beam measurement).
17O 3s 5S°2 hyperfine A: -97.93(10) MHz (Jennerich & Tate 2000) versus -98.59(43) MHz (Marin et al. 1993).
not_found: Isotope shifts of the 777 nm triplet (18O-16O, 18O-17O: Jennerich & Tate, PRA 62, 042506, 2000; Marin et al., Z. Phys. D 25, 191, 1993) and of the 844.6 nm / 3s-3p triplet lines: abstracts confirm the measurements exist, numbers are behind paywalls and no open copy was found.
Far-infrared ground-state fine-structure frequencies and 17O hyperfine / 18O isotope shifts (Zink et al., ApJ 371, L85, 1991; De Natale et al., PRA 48, 3757, 1993): abstract opened, no numbers in it.

Niemi, Schulz-von der Gathen, Doebele (J. Phys. D 34, 2330, 2001; PSST 14, 375, 2005) and Doebele et al. (PSST 14, S31, 2005): publisher pages blocked by a bot wall; the natural lifetime 34.7 ns is second-hand (arXiv:2004.01558) and its uncertainty and the O2/He/Ar quenching coefficients of the originals could not be read.

Direct lifetime measurements of the metastable 1D2 and 1S0 levels and measured forbidden-line A values / the measured 630.0/636.4 nm intensity ratio (Sharpee & Slanger, J. Phys. Chem. A 110, 6707, 2006: page returned 403): not opened; entries are derived from NIST (calculated) A values.

Lifetime of the metastable 3s 5S°2 level (about 180 us follows from the NIST 135.6/135.9 nm A values already in the cached NIST table) and of 3s 3S°1, 3p 5P, 4s 3S°, 3d 3D°, 4p 5P, (2D°)3s 3D°/1D°, 7s, 8s, 6d-8d: no measurement could be opened.
Measured A values for the 777 nm and 844.6 nm lines newer than NIST: none located.
Measured g factors of 1D2 and excited levels; hyperfine constants of 17O other than 2p4 3P2,1, 3s 5S°2, 3p 5P: none located (Marin et al. 1993 also measured triplet 3s-3p lines; not readable).
Precise absolute optical frequencies (frequency-comb or wavemeter-referenced) of O I lines: none located.
Laser cooling of O: no proposal or experiment located.
notes: Level energies are NIST ASD values. Hyperfine constants refer to 17O (I = 5/2); 16O and 18O have I = 0. Kroell et al. label their states only by term (e.g. "2p3 5s 3S", "2p3 3p 3P"); they are triplet states built on the 4S° core. NIST lists the three 5d 3D° levels at one energy (105409.008 cm^-1): the J values distinguish them. TALIF: O(2p4 3P2) + 2 x 225.65 nm -> 3p 3P, fluorescence 844.6 nm to 3s 3S°1; quenching measured by ps-TALIF in arXiv:2004.01558: k(H2O) = 1.1e-9 cm^3 s^-1 and k(He) = 0.032e-10 cm^3 s^-1 for O(3p 3P), effective lifetime 9.6 ns in atmospheric-pressure He. Forbidden-line A values are NIST critically evaluated calculations (not in the cached data/nist line file); M1 and E2 entries at the same wavelength are the two multipole parts of one line. Sources were located through arXiv/DataCite, CORE, HAL, Crossref and publisher abstract pages; the web-search quota of the session was exhausted, so coverage is limited to what those indexes exposed.
